extraction.method: Downloaded official ZH/EN HTML with Invoke-WebRequest; extracted embedded <script type="application/json" id="model-rankings-data|scenarios|weighted|copy"> payloads. boards.name: OpenDesign Arena · Quality ranking
boards.metaDescriptionZh: 面向前端设计场景的 AI 模型评测榜单。所有模型均使用 OpenDesign 同一套私有基准和评分框架。
boards.metaDescriptionEn: An AI model benchmark for frontend design. Every model is evaluated with the same private OpenDesign benchmark and scoring framework.
boards.heroLeadZh: 找到更适合设计任务的 AI 模型。
boards.heroDescriptionZh: 从效果、速度到成本，用真实评测做选择。
boards.note: Primary leaderboard for this archive is the Avg. score ranking under Quality and cost / 效果与成本. Not Elo / not public pairwise votes. Absolute rubric average. Cost/time are reported separately and do not enter Avg. score. Full 13/13 models captured from #model-rankings-data.

boards.name: OpenDesign Arena | Selection score default 50/30/20 / 选型参考分
boards.note: Secondary. Default preference weights quality 50% / cost 30% / speed 20%. Official text: preference changes recommendation order only; does not change original Avg. score. Included for completeness; not the primary evaluation board.

taskMeaning.zh: 各模型围绕统一的设计任务进行评测，覆盖 Web 应用、移动端 App、桌面客户端、看板与管理后台、官网与落地页五类场景。我们评估的是模型在实际原型生成任务中的表现，而非通用能力。
taskMeaning.en: Models are evaluated on shared design tasks across five scenarios: web apps, mobile apps, desktop clients, dashboards and admin panels, and websites and landing pages. These results describe performance on practical prototype-generation tasks, not general model capability.

zhExcerpts: 单份产物满分为 100 分，由需求完成度与设计质量两部分组成。需求完成度占 30 分……设计质量占 70 分……
评测均分是模型所有已评分产物总分的算术平均值，用于比较整体表现。
单份产物达到 80 分，在本评测中视为可交付；可交付率则是已评分产物中达到这一标准的比例……
效率与成本不计入评测总分；切换选型偏好只改变推荐排序，不改变模型的原始评测成绩。
无法渲染的产物按零分计入，不通过补测替换结果。
enExcerpts: Each artifact is scored out of 100. Requirement fulfillment accounts for 30 points… Design quality accounts for 70 points…
The average score is the arithmetic mean of all scored artifacts for a model.
An artifact scoring 80 or above counts as deliverable in this evaluation. Delivery rate is the proportion of scored artifacts that meet this threshold…
Efficiency and cost do not contribute to the evaluation score. Changing selection preferences affects recommendation rankings, not the original evaluation results.
Artifacts that cannot render receive zero; their results are not replaced through retesting.

defaultPreferenceSelectionScoreRounded1d.note: UI shows both at 52.1 under default 50/30/20 preference weights; ranks 12 and 13 on preference list.

confidenceIntervals.note: Each scenario object includes numeric ci95; page tooltips/JS do not label or render it. Meaning not stated on page — stored raw only, not interpreted.

sampleSizes.note: scenario.sampleSize/cases come from #model-rankings-scenarios. Per-model scenario.n values sum to ~26–31 artifacts/model. Exact definition of sampleSize vs n not further glossed on page beyond methodology text about scored artifacts.

score.zh: 平均分：模型所有参评产物总分的平均值，满分 100。越高越好。
score.en: Average score: The mean score across all evaluated artifacts, out of 100. Higher is better.

d1.zh: 平均需求完成度：检查要求的页面、内容、状态和交互是否实现，满分 30。
d1.en: Avg. requirement: Checks whether required pages, content, states, and interactions are present, out of 30.

d2.zh: 平均设计质量：评价布局、层级、风格、颜色和图片适配，满分 70。
d2.en: Avg. design quality: Rates layout, hierarchy, style, color, and image fit, out of 70.

pdr.zh: 可交付率：本次评测中，总分达到 80 的产物占比。
pdr.en: Delivery rate: The share of evaluated artifacts scoring 80 or above.

time.zh: 平均完成耗时：所有已评分产物的实际执行耗时之和，除以产物数量。越低越好。
time.en: Average completion time: Total execution time across scored artifacts divided by their count. Lower is better.

cost.zh: 平均单份成本：按官方标价与实测 Token 用量估算的单份成本。越低越好。
cost.en: Cost per artifact: Estimated from official list prices and measured token usage. Lower is better.
